title: Resolve a merge conflict without losing history
task: While on main, merge feature. Resolve the conflict in settings.txt by keeping theme=auto. Stage the resolution and finish the merge on main.
hints: Run git merge feature and git status.
Replace the conflict block with theme=auto.
Stage settings.txt and commit to complete the merge.

checks.label: The feature history is part of main
checks.feedback: Finish the merge after staging the resolved file.

checks.label: The committed settings contain the resolved theme
checks.feedback: Commit the line theme=auto without conflict markers.

demo.explanation: Both branches changed the same line.

demo.command: git add settings.txt; git commit -m "Resolve theme conflict"
demo.explanation: The merge commit retains both histories.
